headline: DeepSeek dominates; Google's new flash model hits all-time high
summary: DeepSeek continues its iron grip on the rankings at 24.3% provider share, while Google's freshly-minted Gemini 3.7 Flash has already claimed an all-time token-share record on day 2. NVIDIA's free tier is quietly climbing the charts, and Tencent is taking a notable hit after weeks of strength.
highlights: Google/gemini-3.7-flash-20260813 sets all-time record at 2.3% token share (day 2 of streak), debuting at rank 10
DeepSeek/deepseek-v4-flash-20260731 holds rank 1 with 13.9% share, up 0.2% in a day
NVIDIA provider share jumps to 7.7%, up 2.0% overnight—free models driving the surge
Tencent/hy3-20260706 slides to 10.0% share, down 2.8% in 24 hours after weeks of decline
Xiaomi climbs to 3rd place (10.5% share) on a 7-day surge of +5.5%, reversing 30-day losses
Three new entrants: Zhipu AI's GLM 5.3, Google's Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite, and OpenAI's GPT-5 Mini
Anthropic/claude-4.7-opus-20260416 plummets 20 ranks in one day, shedding 0.6% share
